title: Vesper and the Hollow
author: Bram Underhill
blurb: Ines Ashgrove, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
